imageTrace.presets.label: Image Trace Presets
imageTrace.presets.params: {} → {presets: [{name, params, enhanced: the params of the preset's enhanced version, null if it has none}]}

imageTrace.make.label: Make
imageTrace.make.params: {id?: image or Image Trace group (default: selection), preset?: name (imageTrace.presets), enhanced?: false (the preset's enhanced version: with Auto Grouping, and with Shapes in all but High Fidelity Photo; Flat Logo has none and is traced as it is), params?: {mode: "blackAndWhite"|"grayscale"|"color"|"logo", threshold: 0-255, palette: "limited"|"fullTone"|"automatic"|"documentLibrary" (color mode; limited: the `colors` best colours, fullTone: as many as the tones need, more with colorDetail, automatic: flat art with its own colours, else fullTone, documentLibrary: at most `colors` of the library's colours, as they are), colors: 2-256, colorDetail: 0-100 (fullTone, automatic), library: "document" (the document's swatches) or a swatch library id or name (swatch.library.list; documentLibrary), paths: 0-100, corners: 0-100, noise: px, method: "abutting"|"overlapping", ignoreWhite (leave out white areas), ignoreColor?: "#rrggbb" (with ignoreWhite: the colour left out instead of white), snapCurvesToLines, shapes: false (filled outlines that are a circle, an ellipse, a rectangle or a regular polygon come out as that live shape), autoGrouping: false (each path that has others inside it is grouped with them), gradients: false (grayscale and color: an area whose colour changes evenly along one direction is one path with a linear gradient fill), fills: true, strokes: false (Create: lines up to strokeWidth wide become stroked centre lines; without fills, wider areas become stroked outlines), strokeWidth: px (10), logoColors?: ["#rrggbb"…] (mode logo: flat-colour logos only; colours found automatically or named here, white is always its own colour, at most ten; noise = areas under noise/10 px ignored; edges to a fraction of a pixel, sharp corners restored, lines and circles snapped; enclosed transparent areas are painted white unless ignoreWhite makes them holes; fills/strokes are ignored; gradients and photos are refused)}, view?: as imageTrace.setView (default: the traced object's own, else tracingResult), ids?: [id…] (instead of id)} → {id, paths, anchors, colors}

imageTrace.expand.label: Expand
imageTrace.expand.params: {id?, ids?: [id…] (instead of id)} keep only the traced paths (drop the source image) → {ids}

object.path.simplify.params: {tolerance?: pt (1), cornerAngle?: deg (30), straightLines?: bool} → {ids, before, after} anchor counts
